_sheet: Climb stats. One row = one stat a card can push on a PEAK climber. Every effect key in cards.json must be an id here.

_columns.id: C# identifier used in cards.json effects and in the generated ClimbStat enum
_columns.label: player-facing name
_columns.unit: how the number reads: percent, count, perSecond, bool
_columns.appliesVia: which system applies it: effects (public game fields on all clients), hook:<hooks.json id> (Harmony), tick (per-frame on owner)
_columns.gameTarget: the PEAK field or method that changes
_columns.formula: how the total shapes the game value
_columns.display: format string for the card's mountain line; {v} = value as percent or count, {abs} = absolute value
_columns.displayNegative: format for a negative total (empty for flags and stats that cannot go negative)
_columns.invertSign: true when a positive total is bad for the player (hunger): swaps which display string is used
_columns.designNote: why the stat exists and how big a typical card value is

rows.label: Toughness
rows.gameTarget: CharacterAfflictions.AddStatus amount (Injury, Hunger, Cold, Poison, Hot, Drowsy, Spores, Thorns)
rows.display: Injury, hunger, cold and poison build up {v} slower
rows.displayNegative: Injury, hunger, cold and poison build up {abs} faster
rows.designNote: the main defensive stat; commons +0.3, rares up to +1.0

rows.label: Throw force
rows.designNote: fun utility: throwing ropes, food and rocks to friends

rows.label: Stamina regen
rows.gameTarget: Character.UpdateVariablesFixed extra AddStamina(dt * 0.2 * t) when CanRegenStamina()
rows.designNote: the core climbing economy; +0.25 is a noticeable common

rows.label: Campfire bonus stamina
rows.gameTarget: Character.AddExtraStamina(t) on pick and at every lit campfire
rows.displayNegative: {abs} less bonus stamina at every campfire
rows.designNote: yellow bar granted on pick and at every lit fire

rows.label: Run speed
rows.designNote: ground speed; keep small, it compounds with sprint

rows.label: Sprint speed
rows.designNote: sprint multiplier on top of PEAK's own

rows.label: Climb speed
rows.display: Climb walls, ropes and vines {v} faster
rows.displayNegative: Climb walls, ropes and vines {abs} slower
rows.designNote: walls, ropes and vines share one modifier

rows.label: Fall damage
rows.formula: injury * (1 - t), t >= 1 means no fall damage

rows.label: Bouncy landing
rows.formula: on a damaging landing: no injury, upward impulse
rows.display: Hard landings bounce you back up instead of hurting
rows.designNote: hard landings bounce instead of hurting

rows.label: Hunger
rows.designNote: the usual drawback stat; positive is bad

rows.label: Injury regen
rows.display: Injury slowly heals on its own

rows.label: Lifesteal
rows.formula: each thing you eat heals injury by t * 0.1
rows.display: Eating heals {v} of your injury bar

rows.label: Poison resistance
rows.gameTarget: CharacterAfflictions.AddStatus amount for Poison and Spores

rows.label: Second wind
rows.gameTarget: owner tick: when afflictions.shouldPassOut and not yet used this run, ClearAllStatus(false, true) + AddExtraStamina(0.5)
rows.display: Once per climb, passing out is cancelled and you get up healed
rows.designNote: once per climb a pass-out is cancelled
